007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TaskAttributes;
014
015/** Sample for updating multiple DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT task attributes. */
016public final class SetTaskAttributesSample {
017
018    private SetTaskAttributesSample() {
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * Runs the sample using the configured task instruction.
023     *
024     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
025     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
026     */
027    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
028        String taskName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_NAME");
029        TaskAttributes attributes = TaskAttributes.builder()
030                .instruction(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TASK_INSTRUCTION"))
031                .build();
032
033        try (SelectAIAgent selectAIAgent = createClient()) {
034            Task task = selectAIAgent.task(taskName);
035            boolean updated = task.setAttributes(attributes);
036            System.out.printf("Set attributes on task '%s' completed: %s%n", taskName, updated);
037        }
038    }
039
040    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
041        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
042                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
043                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
044                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
045                .build());
046    }
047
048    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
049        String value = System.getenv(name);
050        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
051            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
052        }
053        return value;
054    }
055}
